paragraphs: WisenAI works with senior professionals — people with decades of experience in law, finance, insurance, medicine, engineering and more — to make AI more accurate, more useful and more human-centered. Seniors are paid for their judgment; AI companies get ethically sourced data from people who have actually done the work.
The code for wisenai.com: a Next.js site (App Router, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui) with Clerk sign-in and Resend email, deployed on Vercel.

Configuration lives in environment variables, never in the repository (.env files are git-ignored). The site reads NEXTPUBLICCLERKPUBLISHABLEKEY, CLERKSECRETKEY, the NEXTPUBLICCLERKURL routes, RESENDAPIKEY and ADMINEMAILS; set them in .env.local locally and in the Vercel project for deployments.
